title: Groom Club Monthly Membership Agreement: Monthly Billing, Suspension and Reinstatement
content:
*Tailwise Grooming Salon — Groom Club Monthly membership agreement, billing clauses.*

**1. Monthly fee and visits.** Groom Club Monthly bills its monthly fee, at the rate-card fee for the pet's size class at purchase, on each next billing date, and credits the club's included visits for that month. Unused visits beyond the club's rollover allowance lapse at the start of the new billing month.

**2. Nail trims.** Each billing month also includes the club's allowance of walk-in nail trims; further trims are charged at the walk-in nail trim price.

**3. Declined payment.** A declined monthly fee is retried for the club's payment retry period in calendar days; if it is still unpaid, the club is suspended, no visit is credited and no booking can be made.

**4. Reinstatement.** A suspended club is reinstated when the customer pays the overdue month with a working card, which bills and credits that month. The next billing date of a reinstated club is one month after the overdue billing date.

**5. Automatic cancellation.** After the club's suspension period of calendar days in suspension, the club is cancelled automatically without an early termination fee.

The fee, the included visits, the rollover allowance, the nail-trim allowance and price, the retry period and the suspension period are those of the Groom Club Monthly membership terms schedule and the rate card.

**Status through a declined month (hypothetical member, next billing date 5 April, 3-day retry, 30-day suspension period)**

| Situation | Club status | Visit credited for the month | New bookings |
|---|---|---|---|
| fee collected on 5 April | active | yes | allowed |
| fee still unpaid after the retry period | suspended | no | none can be made |
| customer pays the overdue month with a working card while suspended | active again; that month billed and credited; next billing date 5 May | yes | allowed |
| still suspended after 30 calendar days in suspension | cancelled automatically, no early termination fee | — | — |

**Rollover (hypothetical, rollover allowance of 1)** — a member who ends a billing month with two unused visits keeps one into the new month; the other lapses at the start of the new billing month.
